description: This PHP source file defines the SugarFieldCurrency class, which extends the SugarFieldFloat class. It provides methods for rendering currency fields in list views, sanitizing imported data, and formatting currency values according to locale and user preferences within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: SugarFieldCurrency
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldFloat to handle currency-specific display, import sanitization, and formatting functionalities in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getListViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and assigns currency data for list view rendering, including handling user and locale preferences.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes imported currency values by removing currency symbols and group separators, and trimming based on field length.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Formats raw currency values according to locale-specific number formatting, overriding the base method for currency display.
